fact: The World Bank's 8-12 September 2025 mission to the STP Digital project saw live demonstrations of functional prototypes of the interoperability and data-exchange platform (DEX), being designed and implemented by the System Integrator Ooru with INIC and DGRN, with integration of the interoperability layer with the verifiable credentials infrastructure planned for March 2026.

The World Bank's ISR of 11 April 2025 reports zero government digital systems connected to the national data exchange layer under the project as at 8 April 2025 (target 5 by May 2027), saying Government is looking to implement a government-wide data exchange layer after the ID management system pilot.

The PReSE press release of 1 September 2025 says an interoperability platform between the civil registry databases (SIGA and Bilhete de Identidade) and the electoral roll database is being developed by the University of Aveiro, with DGRN and the national electoral commission technicians trained to maintain it, and was to be presented on 4 September 2025.
system: plataforma de interoperabilidade (registo civil / recenseamento eleitoral)

fact: Ooru Digital, the implementer, says a national Data Exchange Layer is introduced in Phase 2 (2026) of a programme in active implementation by DGRN and INIC, to link ministries' systems.
